name: isCrossAccountBackupEnabled
definition: At least one enabled replication rule copies a bucket to a bucket in a different storage account.
population: the buckets the backup storage account lists, with their outbound replication rules
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A bucket list in which an enabled outbound replication rule names a destination bucket that is not one of the account's own listed buckets.
citations: Backblaze B2 native API reference, b2_list_buckets: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-buckets

changeLog.change: Registered with the Backblaze B2 transforms, its first implementation.

notes: Backblaze B2: replicationConfiguration.asReplicationSource.replicationRules. Needs a key that sees every bucket.
